panels.title: Events over time (by type)
panels.description: analytics.behavioral_events, bucketed by time. Uses COALESCE(occurred_at, received_at): synthetic seed data only sets occurred_at (spread over the last 60 days), live events only set received_at (the moment the API ingested them) — see app/analytics/models.py and app/api/analytics_client.py. The COALESCE is computed in a subquery, not passed directly to $__timeGroup/$__timeFilter — those macros' argument parsing breaks on a comma inside nested parens.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(event_time, '$__interval') AS "time",
  event_type AS "metric",
  count(*) AS "value"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(occurred_at, received_at) AS event_time, event_type
  FROM analytics.behavioral_events
) e
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recommendation -> click -> apply/save funnel
panels.description: Total event counts by type across the selected time range — read top to bottom as the funnel: recommendation_shown -> recommendation_clicked -> job_applied/job_saved.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_type, count(*) AS events
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(occurred_at, received_at) AS event_time, event_type
  FROM analytics.behavioral_events
) e
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY event_type
ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT
  CASE WHEN sum((event_type = 'recommendation_shown')::int) = 0 THEN 0
  ELSE 100.0 * sum((event_type = 'recommendation_clicked')::int) / sum((event_type = 'recommendation_shown')::int)
  END AS click_through_rate
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(occurred_at, received_at) AS event_time, event_type
  FROM analytics.behavioral_events
) e
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)

SELECT
  CASE WHEN sum((event_type = 'recommendation_clicked')::int) = 0 THEN 0
  ELSE 100.0 * sum((event_type = 'job_applied')::int) / sum((event_type = 'recommendation_clicked')::int)
  END AS apply_rate
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(occurred_at, received_at) AS event_time, event_type
  FROM analytics.behavioral_events
) e
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)

SELECT actor_type, count(DISTINCT actor_id) AS distinct_actors
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(occurred_at, received_at) AS event_time, actor_type, actor_id
  FROM analytics.behavioral_events
) e
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY actor_type
ORDER BY actor_type

panels.title: Active users per day (by actor type)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(event_time, '1d') AS "time",
  actor_type AS "metric",
  count(DISTINCT actor_id) AS "value"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(occurred_at, received_at) AS event_time, actor_type, actor_id
  FROM analytics.behavioral_events
) e
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent activity (raw events)
panels.description: The "what did user X just do" view — most recent behavioral_events rows first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(occurred_at, received_at) AS time,
  actor_type,
  actor_id,
  event_type,
  entity_type,
  entity_id,
  source,
  session_id
FROM analytics.behavioral_events
ORDER BY COALESCE(occurred_at, received_at) DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Recent edits (audit trail)
panels.description: entity_change_log — who changed which field on a candidate_details/job_details record, old -> new, and when. See app/audit/.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  changed_at AS time,
  entity_type,
  entity_id,
  changed_by_keycloak_user_id AS changed_by,
  changes::text AS changes
FROM entity_change_log
ORDER BY changed_at DESC
LIMIT 200
